test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The rabbit __was remain stationary__ to avoid being seen.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original underlined part **"was remain stationary"** is incorrect because of the improper verb form used with **"was."**
 
• The correct verb form after **"was"** should be the past participle, making "remained stationary" the appropriate choice.
 
• **"Remained"** refers to staying in the same place, condition, or situation, especially when it is held or managed with difficulty.

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *"The rabbit **remained stationary** to avoid being seen." *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: **"remain stationary"** is incorrect as it doesn't follow the proper tense agreement with "was."
 
• Option 4: **"were remained stationary"** is also incorrect due to improper verb form and tense agreement.
